items.title: Structural Engineer - Solar Arrays (f/m/d)
items.content_html:
About the role

Space hardware must survive launch before it can perform its mission. Your analyses and tests will prove that it can.

As Structural Engineer - Solar Arrays (f/m/d), you will verify the structures and mechanisms that enable Dcubed's solar arrays to survive launch and deploy successfully in orbit. Through a combination of advanced simulation, first-principles engineering, and hands-on testing, you will turn ambitious designs into flight-ready hardware.

If you enjoy understanding the physics behind complex systems, challenging assumptions, and validating your work through testing, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Perform structural analyses of solar arrays, deployable structures, mechanisms, and hold-down and release systems.

  • Develop and validate FEM models for static, dynamic, thermoelastic, buckling, and non-linear analyses.

  • Size composite and metallic structures, bonded joints, bolted interfaces, and inserts, and calculate structural margins of safety.

  • Use analytical calculations and engineering judgement to cross-check simulation results and verify model assumptions.

  • Support the design of lightweight structures and mechanisms capable of surviving launch loads and deploying successfully in orbit.

  • Define and lead structural test campaigns, including vibration, static load, deployment, and thermal testing.

  • Define loads, instrumentation, notching approaches, test predictions, and pass/fail criteria.

  • Participate in test execution, investigate anomalies, correlate models, and support verification closure.

  • Build and test coupons, prototypes, and representative hardware to generate material data and validate analytical models.

  • Prepare structural analyses, test reports, and verification documentation, and support internal and customer reviews.

Candidate Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of experience in structural analysis and testing of aerospace, space, or other high-performance structures.

  • Experience taking hardware from analysis through testing and verification.

  • Experience with composite structures, deployable systems, mechanisms, or spacecraft hardware is highly desirable.

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of structural mechanics, dynamics, vibration, and load-path analysis.

  • Advanced FEM knowledge and strong experience with FEMAP and Nastran NX.

  • Experience with Ansys and LS-Dyna is considered an advantage.

  • Experience performing static, modal, random vibration, transient, buckling, thermoelastic, and non-linear analyses.

  • Experience sizing composite and metallic structures, bolted joints, inserts, and bonded interfaces.

  • Ability to assess structural margins and independently verify simulation results using first-principles calculations.

  • Experience defining and executing structural test campaigns, including instrumentation, notching, and model correlation.

  • Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for engineering calculations and data analysis.

  • Familiarity with ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace structural standards.

Personal Attributes

  • Analytical, rigorous, and driven to understand the physics behind the results.

  • Strong sense of ownership from analysis through successful test execution.

  • Hands-on mindset with a willingness to prototype, instrument, and test hardware.

  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

  • Effective communicator and team player in a multidisciplinary environment.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Excellent English language skills.

  • Eligibility to work in Germany

What we offer

We want you to feel welcome and have the best possible tools for your work here at Dcubed. Therefore, we have selected a set of benefits to support your work days and everyday life, today and longer term.

  • Commute: Deutschlandticket

  • Wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass, recovery toolkit

  • ETF-based pension program offering 30-50% company contribution

  • Modern work equipment, based on your role and needs: laptop, phone, headphones, electric desk, wide screens, state-of-the-art workshop equipment

  • Office environment: kitchen and break areas; lunch offering, beverages & snacks at the office; small exercise area, Space Bar

  • Work-life balance & activities: hybrid work arrangements (location and working hours), company events and trips, launch parties

  • Professional development: 70-20-10 thinking, training budget, training library, regular performance reviews

  • Company swag: hoodie, t-shirt, stickers, water bottle, notebook etc.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. and/or Germany export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant's capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. and/or Germany export controls.

Please note: Dcubed does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies and will not pay fees for any candidates we have not requested.

items.title: Senior Engineering Projects Manager
items.content_html:
As a Senior Engineering Projects Manager, you bring a mix of mechanical engineering / mechatronics expertise with experience managing a small team’s tasks, schedules and budget. You will lead by example through the mentorship of less senior engineers across mechanical, electrical, and systems disciplines, in addition to performing design or analysis in support of Dcubed USA technical programs.

This role is a mix between acting as an engineering subject matter expert, team lead, and project manager.

What you will do:

  • Provide management of a multi-functional technical team and associated projects supporting Dcubed engineering functions

  • Perform design or analysis of structures, mechanisms, or mechatronic systems dependent on your specific strengths or expertise.

  • Knowledge of electrical systems and avionics a plus

  • Assist with the management of external contractors for engineering services

  • Mentor less-senior engineers on engineering and project management topics

  • Support hardware procurement including the identification, vetting, and management of new vendors supporting Dcubed engineering projects.

Must-haves:

  • Education: Bachelor's of Science in Aerospace, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Electrical Engineering with at least 7 years experience

  • Experience working on spaceflight hardware, with an emphasis on hands-on experience

  • Past project and/or team management experience

  • A passion for working with small, fast paced teams

  • A technical strength in one or more of the following areas: Mechanical Design & Drafting (CAD – Solidworks preferred), Finite Element Analysis (ANYSYS, NASTRAN, FEMAP, etc), Thermal Analysis (Thermal Desktop preferred), Mechanisms Design & Analysis, Mechatronics Systems

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary range: $120,000 - 160,000 per year (based on experience and qualification)

  • Flexible PTO and sick leave

  • Hybrid work flexibility when applicable

  • Premium Coffee, Beverage, and Snack Bar at the office

  • Dog friendly environment

  • Team events

  • Opportunities for professional growth with a rapidly scaling aerospace company

  • For full-time employees:

  • Competitive health insurance (medical, vision, dental)

  • 401(k), plus company matching

  • Discounted Pet Health Insurance

About Us

Dcubed is a fast-growing NewSpace company headquartered in Germering/Munich which accelerates space exploration through durable and affordable space hardware. Our easy-to-use and readily available space mechanisms and subsystems (solar arrays, deployable structures) have flown over a dozen times to space and are used by many of the leading space companies in the world. We are an inclusive workplace where all are welcome (f/m/d).

Equal Opportunity Employer

Dcubed is an Equal Opportunity (EO) employer and recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, or other protected status under applicable law.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. and/or Germany export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant's capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. and/or Germany export controls.

Please note: Dcubed does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies and will not pay fees for any candidates we have not requested.

items.title: Open Application
items.content_html:
Hey there!

We always publish our open positions on our website. However, if you are unable to find an open position that matches with your experience and skills, you may send us an open application and CV, detailing your background and interest in Dcubed and why working in the space industry motivates you.

Also, if you are looking for an internship, traineeship or a working student position, this is your place to be. We will get back to you, if we are able to offer an internship or a traineeship in your area of interest.

Please note that due to GDPR, we at Dcubed will only accept applications received via our website. We will not respond to those sent via email or contact form.

Kind regards,

Dcubed Recruitment Team

Please note: Dcubed does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies and will not pay fees for any candidates we have not requested.
